notes: Version 2.48 records the Gravity restoration lot: Gravity 3.7 and Foundation 2.7. Gravity 3.7 cites the white paper's theorem that admissible injective projections have trivial holonomy (Appendix A.9, Theorem A.1) in its exact scope, a smooth fibre-bundle map supporting a connection in the principal case, states that its own projection is not shown to satisfy these hypotheses, and removes the sentences that drew from it a conclusion on the curvature of the effective geometry. A footnote of Gravity 3.7 corrects the provenance of the finite-q admissibility-weight values withdrawn in version 3.5: they are reproducible from the simulation code published with Q5a, their modulation terms equal 2 exactly by the normalisation of the fingerprint vectors on full-rank pairs, their shift terms are only numerically close to 2 on average, and they do not bear on Hypothesis [H-w], which remains open. Foundation 2.7 withdraws the sentence that read the closeness of these values to 2 as consistent with a q-independent attractor of the admissible spectral flow. The registry entry of Foundation now refers to version 2.7. No status, graph node or edge changes.
